course_name_original: Redacción de textos científico-técnicos en Euskara (GMN204)
course_name_en: Scientific and Technical Text Writing in Basque

learning_outcomes.text: Awareness of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Define the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, and using correct language, in writing.
Define the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, and using correct language, orally.

syllabus_topics: Formulation of diverse sentences and texts (hypothetical-conditional, final and causal sentences, results-concessive and consecutive sentences, comparisons for decision-making-comparative and the verbal person).
Characteristics of text structures according to their typology (textual grammar)
teaching_methods: Professor's presentation in the classroom, in participatory classes, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects
Workshops, debates, seminars, case studies, role-playing

assessment_methods.method: Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject

assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of individual written and oral tests. There are no resit mechanisms.
